test_title: PYST 46 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the following sentence parts to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:

P. He connected the modem to the wall and the wireless router to the modem.

Q. He followed the setup wizard on his computer, configuring the network's name and password.

R. He connected all his devices to the new network, from his phone to his smart TV.

S. He performed a speed test, confirming his home now had a strong and reliable connection.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph follows a chronological and logical progression of setting up a technical system, starting with physical installation and ending with performance verification.
 
• **Sentence P is the first sentence** as it establishes the physical foundation required for the process:
 
 
• "He connected the modem to the wall and the wireless router to the modem."
 
 
 
• **Sentence Q follows** because once the hardware is physically linked, the next logical step is to configure the software settings:
 
 
• "He followed the setup wizard on his computer, configuring the network's name and password."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R is the third sentence** as it describes the action taken once the network is live and secured:
 
 
• "He connected all his devices to the new network, from his phone to his smart TV."
 
 
 
• **Sentence S is the fourth** because it represents the final step of the process—verifying that the setup was successful and functional:
 
 
• "He performed a speed test, confirming his home now had a strong and reliable connection."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **PQRS**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"He connected the modem to the wall and the wireless router to the modem. He followed the setup wizard on his computer, configuring the network's name and password. He connected all his devices to the new network, from his phone to his smart TV. He performed a speed test, confirming his home now had a strong and reliable connection."
